Background & Education

Born and raised in Ramanathapuram, Tamil Nadu, I developed an early technical fascination with network architecture and digital defenses.

I am currently pursuing my B.Tech in Cybersecurity at Sri Shakthi Institute of Engineering and Technology, Coimbatore (2024–2028, Current GPA: 7.7 / 10.0). Prior to university, I completed Higher Secondary at Syed Ammal HSS (77.17%) and SSLC at MGR Matriculation School (66.0%).

Bilingual fluency in English and Tamil with comprehensive practical exposure across Linux, Kali Linux, and security scripting.

Defensive Mindset & SOC Focus

"To build an effective defense, you must understand the attacker's methodology."

My primary operational objective is proactive threat detection — identifying lateral movement, investigating anomalous spikes, and automating alert triage before breach escalation occurs.

This motivation led me to architect mcp-security-copilot, connecting Wazuh SIEM telemetry to VirusTotal threat intelligence and generating automated incident reports mapped to the MITRE ATT&CK framework.
